item.title: I spent $220 on Google app ads and 60% of the installs were robots
item.description:
📝 50, and Google couldn’t find installs at that price. Over the whole two weeks: 56 installs billed, 33 with that pattern, 7 more from countries the campaign wasn’t targeting, and 13 people. Google optimizes for whatever goal you give it, and my goal was installs.
🔗 Read more: https://dayzlegame.com/blog/google-ads-bot-farm/

item.title: Project Blinkenlights
item.description:
📝 Project Blinkenlights 해야 할 일이 있습니다. Project Blinkenlights는 건물을 거대한 대화형 디스플레이로 바꿔줍니다. 뉴스 Stereoscope 문서 비디오 2009년 8월 19일 Blinkenlights가 트위터에 갑니다. 2009년 4월 6일 Blinkenlights @ Küchenradio 2008년 11월 12일 Stereoscope가 Nuit Blanche People's Choice Award를 수상했습니다. 2008년 10월 24일 이번 화요일 토론토에서 Blinkenlights 기술 토크 2008년 10월 14일 모든 뉴스.
🔗 Read more: https://blinkenlights.de/en/

item.title: Show HN: ResolveHQ – A Helpdesk Built on Cloudflare Workers, D1, R2 and Queues
item.description:
📝 Receive mail through Cloudflare Email Routing and send it through Resend, with delivery status, retries, and idempotent webhooks. Cloudflare Email Routing delivers incoming mail to the Worker, and Resend sends outgoing mail. Tickets and attachments are stored in your Cloudflare account; outbound email content passes through Resend.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/mirza-rizvi/ResolveHQ

item.title: Txt: A fast, keyboard-driven terminal text editor for engineers
item.description:
📝 rulers = [80, 120]) Find & replace with regex and case-sensitive modes File sidebar with full file management (create, rename, delete, move),. Usage Open a file or a directory: txt file. Opening a directory brings up the file sidebar automatically.
